settings.title: Settings
settings.language_help: Used for this app and for notifications.
settings.interval_help: Parcels out for delivery are checked four times as often, waiting ones less often. Delivered ones not at all.
settings.auto_archive_help: 0 keeps them in the overview until you archive them.
settings.budget_help: Answered today: {used} of {budget}. Failed tries do not count.
settings.apprise_help: One per line, for example gotifys://host/token or ntfy://topic. Covers Gotify, ntfy, Telegram, e-mail and many more. For Gotify, gotifys:// means HTTPS and gotify:// HTTP; no https:// in front and no /message behind, and the token is an app token.
settings.push_blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings.
settings.push_unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications here. On iPhone, add the app to the home screen first.
settings.event_out_for_delivery: a parcel is out for delivery
settings.event_ready_for_pickup: a parcel is ready for pickup
settings.event_pickup_reminder: a pickup period is about to end
settings.quiet_help: Messages wait until the quiet hours end.
settings.import_failed: This is not a Parcel Master export.
settings.connect_help: This can take up to a minute. Nothing is saved unless the sign-in works.
settings.sync_every_help: Leave empty for the default. Not more often than every 30 minutes, so the sign-ins do not look suspicious.
settings.pace_tracker: Checked every {minutes} minutes; out for delivery every {fast}, parcels standing still or waiting for pickup less often.
settings.pace_importer: Sync every {minutes} minutes; every 30 while the service itself has a parcel out for delivery.
settings.saver_help: Asks carriers less without missing the delivery day: nothing during the night rest set above, announced parcels every six hours, parcels still days away twice a day and Amazon parcels go to a carrier with scarce lookups (DHL through its API) only once they are out for delivery. Refresh by hand always works.
settings.saver_status: Saver on: no lookups between {from} and {to}.
settings.event_delivery_window: a carrier names a delivery window
settings.push_help: Each browser or phone is switched on by itself. They arrive even while this page is closed.
settings.push_devices_0: No device is signed up yet.
settings.push_test_sent: Sent. It should show up within seconds.
settings.push_test_gone: The browser has dropped the sign-up. Switch it off and on again.
settings.push_failed: The browser could not sign up for notifications. {reason}
settings.app_ready: Puts Parcel Master on the home screen, with its own window and notifications.
settings.app_ios: On iPhone and iPad: open this page in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
settings.app_manual: Open the browser menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to home screen". If it is already installed, open it from there.
settings.log_help: The newest lines first. Level: {level}. Set PM_LOG_LEVEL=debug on the container for more detail.
settings.event_stops: the number of stops before delivery drops
settings.companion_help: A userscript for your browser (Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey). It passes on to Parcel Master what the carrier's page shows you, asks nothing there itself and sends only to this server.

login.demo_hint: The demo uses made-up parcels. Nothing you do there is kept.

demo.banner: Demo mode. Made-up parcels, nothing is kept.

error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait five minutes.
error.unknown_carrier: Choose a carrier for every parcel.
error.invalid_tracking_number: A tracking number is too short.
error.order_alone: Add an order on its own; its parcels come with it.
error.invalid_reference: That does not look like an order number.
error.invalid_saver_hours: Enter the night rest as hh:mm.

carrier_error.not_configured: No key set up for this carrier.
carrier_error.not_found: The carrier does not know this number yet.
carrier_error.rate_limited: The carrier is limiting requests right now.
carrier_error.budget_exhausted: Today's lookups are used up. Next check tomorrow.
carrier_error.invalid_response: The carrier sent an answer that could not be read.
carrier_error.unknown_carrier: The module for this carrier is missing.
carrier_error.needs_code: The service asked for a two-step code. Add the two-step secret key, then sync again.
carrier_error.needs_person: The service wants a check only a person can pass (captcha or approval). Sign in once in a browser, then sync again.
carrier_error.sign_in_failed: The sign-in did not go through. Check e-mail and password; the service's own message is below.
carrier_error.browser_failed: The browser needed for the sign-in check failed.
carrier_error.invalid_otp_secret: That is not a two-step secret key. It is the long key of letters A–Z and digits 2–7 that Amazon shows when you add an authenticator app, not the six-digit code.
carrier_error.not_connected: Connect the account in the settings first.
carrier_error.too_many_tries: A lot of lookups within the last hour. Parcel Master pauses briefly and then asks again by itself.

pickup_reminder.body: Pick it up soon: {days} days left.
